# Ticket T02

The gateway records the pending batches and keeps the previous copy for audit.
The queue consumer throttles each heartbeat window so later stages see a consistent view.
A retry loop rotates the overflow buffer before the next window opens.
The gateway replays the overflow buffer unless an operator pins the revision.
The metrics exporter compacts its local snapshot and reports the outcome to the journal.
The scheduler replays a shard manifest so later stages see a consistent view.
The ingest service rotates the overflow buffer before the next window opens.
The audit trail rotates the idle connections so later stages see a consistent view.
The metrics exporter reconciles the session table and keeps the previous copy for audit.

## Action

Set `s09.retries` to `6` in config/app.conf.
